text:
Alex: quick ping — PR #3182 is blocked by a naming lint failure after my shortname refactor. CI shows inconsistent capitalization across files. can someone eyeball?
Morgan: saw it. looks like one file still references `ShortName` (exported) while others use `shortName`. did you intend to make it unexported?
Alex: intended unexported. must have missed a usage in pkg/http/handler.go.
Jamie: can you paste the golangci output?
Alex: CI-bot: `pkg/http/handler.go:45:6: exported type ShortName should have comment or be unexported (golint)` and `pkg/model/user.go:12:6: type shortName should be ShortName to be exported` — honestly the diff flipped some names during the refactor.
Morgan: aha. two-way mismatch. easiest fix: keep it unexported everywhere (shortName) and update the handler to use the package-local accessor. that won't affect public API?
Alex: correct — it's internal to our service. no public surface.
Sara: if it's internal, prefer unexported. also run `gofmt` and `gofumpt` before pushing. I can approve once CI is green. :thumbsup:
Alex: will push a small amend in a minute. going to run `gofmt -w` and search/replace for `ShortName` -> `shortName` where appropriate.
Jamie: leave a note in the PR description about the refactor so we don't confuse future reviewers. maybe add a one-liner in the changelog.
Alex: done. added PR comment: "unexport ShortName as part of internal refactor; no public API change."
Alex: pushed fix `git commit --amend --no-edit && git push --force-with-lease`
CI-bot: build started for branch refactor/shortname-fix
CI-bot: golangci-lint passed. unit tests running...
Morgan: pinging for approval — I can review now.
Jamie: quick skim looks fine. two nits: 1) struct field order changed in user.go (move ID before name), 2) can we avoid a big static replace if there are unrelated matches? small manual check is fine.
Alex: reverted an accidental reorder; ran a targeted grep to avoid unrelated matches.
Sara: thanks. approving now. :white_check_mark:
Morgan: approved from me too — merging during next merge window unless someone objects.
Jamie: no objections.
Alex: thanks all. merging after CI finishes and then I'll monitor for any fallout.
Sara: nice, thx for the quick turnaround!
